description: Kirala wears a cream and pale gold floor-length textured gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length shaped sleeves. Gold-brown geometric woven or embroidered borders decorate the neckline, central front, waist, sleeve bands and hem. A burgundy patterned wrap with gold borders rests along the arms and hangs to the lower skirt. Small gold-toned earrings and a bracelet accompany two round decorative waist fittings and hanging ornament. A modest low skirt opening shows an ankle and a decorated closed flat shoe. Fabric remains substantial and opaque, with exact fibers uncertain. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
